Classical pilgrimage teaching places Kunj Bihari Temple, Jodhpur within India’s tirtha network: a location where devotion to Lord Krishna (Kunj Bihari) is believed to ripen vows more readily than in ordinary space. Epic, Puranic, and regional mahatmya literature — not a single uniform text — sustain this sense of sacred geography.

Local sthala-purana and priestly teaching at Kunj Bihari Temple, Jodhpur elaborate how Lord Krishna (Kunj Bihari) blesses devotees who arrive with vows, gratitude, or grief. Festival days intensify these beliefs through processions, special alankara, and community feeding where practised.
